alert.asset: Hold the asset tag to the top of your phone.
alert.credential: Hold the badge or wristband to the top of your phone.
alert.lookup: Hold the tag to the top of your phone.
alert.receiving: Hold the tag on the case to the top of your phone.
alert.write: Hold a blank NFC sticker to the top of your phone to write {tag}.

failed: The tag could not be read. Hold it still at the top of the phone and try again.
off: NFC is off. Turn it on in your phone's settings, then try again.

test.contentHelp: Type a code. For a tag with no code, type serial: and its serial number.
test.present: Hold the tag to the phone
test.title: Test NFC tag

unreadable: This tag holds no code Compass can read.
writeFailed: The tag could not be written. Use a blank NFC sticker that is not locked, and try again.
